variants.label: commercial_break_available_close
variants.notes: Manually inspected exact close X. Left portion avoids cursor highlight at the right edge; two fixed commercial-break anchors still independently required. Development regression fa7548cc matches .97278 with unchanged .97 threshold.

variants.label: wsop_finished_available_close
variants.notes: Finished native advertisement manually inspected; two static title patches and the independently visible top-right close control. No Install or creative interactions authorized.

variants.label: foodcity_available_advance
variants.notes: Manually inspected normal available top-right advance control in a two-ad sequence. Only visible reference control plus both identity anchors authorize advancement; no creative or destination interaction. Intermediate advance is not asserted to return directly to the game.

variants.label: gnomon_second_ad_available_advance
variants.notes: Manually inspected normal available top-right advance control in a two-ad sequence. Only visible reference control plus both identity anchors authorize advancement; no creative or destination interaction. Intermediate advance is not asserted to return directly to the game.

variants.label: meta_chrome_skip_available
variants.notes: Meta Audience Network skip-forward glyph at the top-right of the game area; the same glyph is the evidence and the control. Observed across single-pane end cards, two-pane video layouts and different creatives (Whole Moon, Food City, Gnomon). Clicked only after two stable fresh frames. No creative pixel is evidence.

variants.label: meta_chrome_video_muted
variants.notes: Meta Audience Network muted-speaker glyph at the top-left of the game area during the video phase; no control, so recognition only extends the bounded no-input advertisement wait. Observed in Whole Moon and Food City video phases and the Fingersoft commercial-break pre-roll.

variants.label: admob_small_layout_skip
variants.notes: Google-served video interstitial rendered by the emulator as a small player in the top-left corner over a black letterbox, with a dim skip-forward glyph at the extreme top-right of the game area and a static marker below the player's bottom-right corner. Only the exact skip glyph patch is clickable, after two stable frames; the creative, its Install pill and the player are never controls.

variants.label: vehicle_select_hill_climber
variants.notes: Vehicle selection screen shown after a cold boot with HILL CLIMBER selected; the vehicle title is an identity anchor. Start is the only control; Shop, Stage, Vehicle previews, boosters and currency are never actionable. Captured after the emulator crash/relaunch during Cycle 2.

variants.label: admob_tiny_layout_close
variants.notes: Google-served interstitial end card rendered by the emulator as a small card in the top-left corner over a black letterbox, with a tiny Close text pill at the extreme top-right of the game area that appears several seconds after the card. Anchors are the Close pill and the static container marker at the card's bottom-right corner; the creative, its title and its Install pill are never controls. Clicked only after two stable frames.

variants.label: out_of_fuel_native
variants.notes: Native OUT OF FUEL result of the current game build captured during reliability study session 2: static header and DISTANCE label establish the state; the separately visible TOUCH TO CONTINUE glyph patch is the only control. The Cycle 1 discovery reference matched this native layout at only 0.85 and is retained unchanged. The screen also shows +GEMS/+COINS lines and bonus tallies (AIR TIME, FLIP, BACK FLIP, NECK FLIP), which are reader targets, never controls.

variants.label: admob_medium_layout_skip
variants.notes: Google-served video interstitial rendered by the emulator at a third player size with its companion install card; the dim skip-forward glyph at the extreme top-right is byte-identical to the small-layout reference and the card's static RATINGS/CATEGORY/DEVELOPER label row is the second anchor. The creative, its Install pill and the player are never controls. Clicked only after two stable frames.
